sources.label: Wikipedia, "Zeta Geminorum"
sources.quote: Zeta Geminorum is a bright star with cluster components, distant optical components and a likely spectroscopic partner in the zodiac constellation of Gemini — in its south, on the left 'leg' of the twin Pollux.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 4,497 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,335 K, so 78.606 solar radii.
